To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
pectin is an excellent carrier for fat-soluble drugs, and the release of the drug can be adjusted by blending with different polysaccharides.
the natural polysac-charides involving pectins, chitosan, and sodium alginate are excellent carriers of fat-soluble drugs, and the drug release properties are different in different media.
the pectin-based composite film has the potential to become a new type of drug carrier for fat-soluble drugs.

the preparation of pectin film loaded with Cur and the effect of natural polysac-charides on the sustained release of curcumin.
the development of a new drug delivery system for curcumin, and the results are helpful for the further application of curcumin in the pharmaceutical and food fields.
a novel curcumin film, which can be used in drug controlled release and drug delivery system.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

PT-CS-Curf and PT-SA-Curf were suitable for oral administration of curcumin, and the release rate of curcumin in PT-SA-Curf was slower, which could prolong the retention of curcumin on the surface of the gastrointestinal tract and increase the bioavailability of curcumin.
pectin is the most suitable carrier of curcumin.

the pectin-curcumin film (P-Curf) has the best sustained release effect, while the pectin sodium alginate curcunim film (PT-SA- Curf) has the best drug loading effect, and the pectin chitosan curcunim (PT-CS- Curf) film is the best in terms of film strength.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the pectin-based films were excellent carriers of curcumin and the pectin-cationic polysaccharides composite films could be applied as sustained-release curcumin drug delivery systems.
PT-SA-Curf was the best drug delivery system, which could be applied to the preparation of oral controlled-release curcumin film.
the natural polysac-charides could improve the solubility and stability of curcumin, and could be applied in sustained release of fat-soluble drugs.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the PT-CS-Curf and PT-SA-Curf films have potential applications as drug delivery systems.

PT-SA-Curf is the most suitable drug carrier for curcumin, which is of great significance for the preparation of sustained release curcumin film and its application in the food and pharmaceutical industry.
the PT-CS-Curf and PT-SA-Curf can be used for sustained release and controlled release of Cur in the future.
